title: Make the POSIX path-literal tests portable instead of skipping them on Windows
notes:
PR #197 skips 26 tests on Windows with `posixPathsOnly` because their expected values are POSIX literals such as /work/app. Every function behind them goes through node:path (exportTarget, docScope, fileCandidates, worktreePathFor, projectOfFolder, pickedFolder, projectNamed, firstProjectsFile, the project CLI and requests), so building fixtures with path.resolve("/work/app") and expecting path.join(base, "notes", "a.txt") keeps them on both platforms. Skipped, the Windows job never runs the branches only Windows reaches: for example exportTarget's startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) check takes a backslash there, and nothing checks that a name like notes\a.txt stays inside the folder.

Files: src/main/app/projects.test.ts, src/main/chat/chat-export-target.test.ts, src/main/drawer/docs-list.test.ts, src/main/nvim/file-open.test.ts, src/main/projects/project-cli.test.ts, src/main/projects/project-named.test.ts, src/main/projects/project-requests.test.ts, src/main/projects/projects-first.test.ts, src/main/ship/ship.test.ts, src/main/workers/session-requests.test.ts.

Done when `grep -rn posixPathsOnly src/` prints nothing.

Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/197#discussion_r4441552042
